data.title: bn-jhd7: Fresh-eyes review of post-pre.13 changes
data.description: Fresh-eyes review of randomly sampled post-v1.0.0-pre.13 paths. Fixes an auto-rebase verifier lock gap and rejects relative corrupt failpoint targets. Includes focused regressions, full just check, and failpoints clippy.

data.body: LOW: Security-positive hardening. Requiring an absolute target for the `corrupt:<path>` failpoint reduces blast radius; a relative path could corrupt the wrong worktree checkout. Confirmed this primitive plus MAW_FP parsing is fully gated behind #[cfg(feature = "failpoints")], so it is never in a shipped binary.

INFO: Holding the workspace lock through verify_sibling_materialization closes a TOCTOU race: the verifier can rewrite the sibling worktree, and releasing first would let a concurrent maw process race legitimate edits into the repair window (Prime-Invariant / data-loss risk). Lock lifetime is sound - single drop, no leak, record_rebase_notice after drop only writes an oplog notice.

data.reason: Security review clean. Lock-through-verify closes a TOCTOU data-loss window; absolute-path corrupt requirement hardens a test-only primitive fully gated behind the failpoints feature. No injection/secret/auth surface in shipped code.
